appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How the launcher looks and which language it speaks. Saved on this computer.

themeDescriptions.dark: Dark uses deep neutral greys, easy on the eyes.
themeDescriptions.black: Black uses true black, for OLED screens.
themeDescriptions.light: Light uses warm paper tones, for bright rooms.

appearance.languageDescription: The launcher's language. System follows your computer's.

account.title: Account
account.description: Signing in registers this machine, so labs you launch from the website run here.
account.signInHint: Sign in with your Cyber account to sync labs and run them from any device.

labs.title: Labs
labs.description: How labs start on this machine. Saved on this computer only.

labPorts.title: Lab ports
labPorts.default: Each service on its own port, like CTFd on 8000. A start stops when another lab or app already holds one.
labPorts.random: Each service on a free random port. Never collides with another lab or app.
labPorts.ask: Asks before each container lab starts on this machine: random free ports, or the lab's own.

attackBox.title: Attack box image
attackBox.description: Runs on each lab’s network as your toolbox. The first launch of an image downloads it, which can take a while.

presets.cyberctf: Kali with its standard toolset, ready to use
presets.kali: Official Kali base, add tools as needed
presets.exegolFree: Exegol Community: full toolkit, updated after Full; for learning and personal use
presets.exegolFull: The latest Exegol toolkit; needs an Exegol Pro, Team or Enterprise plan

attackBox.customImageNote: Any Docker image or registry tag.
attackBox.autoStart: Start the attack box with the lab
attackBox.autoStartDescription: Starts it as soon as a lab is up on this machine: the container on a container lab, the VM beside a VM lab. You can still start or stop it from the lab.
attackBox.invalidImage: Use a plain image name such as registry/name:tag: letters, digits and . _ - / : @ only, not starting with a dash.

attackVm.title: Attack VM for VM labs
attackVm.description: A VM lab’s networks live inside the hypervisor, so your attacker is a VM beside it: this Vagrant box, plugged into every lab network, with the internet to install tools. The first start downloads the box.
attackVm.label: Attack VM box

presets.kali: Official Kali box; it has the internet, add tools as you go
presets.debian12: A plain base to build your own toolset on

attackVm.customBoxNote: Any Vagrant Cloud box (owner/name) built for your hypervisor.

hypervisor.title: Hypervisor for VM labs
hypervisor.setupLink: Set one up on the Machine page
hypervisor.noneInstalled: No hypervisor is installed on this machine yet.
hypervisor.current: VM labs and the VM test run on {name}.
hypervisor.noneReady: None of the installed hypervisors can run VM labs yet. Install its Vagrant add-on below.
hypervisor.notReady: Installed · not ready for VM labs
hypervisor.logAllowingHyperv: Adding your account to Hyper-V Administrators (Windows asks for permission)…
hypervisor.logHypervAllowed: ✓ Done. Sign out of Windows and back in, then re-check.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Tear down anything still running on this machine (a leftover or stuck lab), reclaim disk from downloaded images and VM boxes, and remove tools Cyber CTF installed.

installedTools.title: Tools Cyber CTF installed
installedTools.intro: Installed during setup. Remove the ones you no longer need; tools you had before aren't listed.
installedTools.confirmBody: Labs that need {name} won't start until it's installed again (setup can reinstall it). Your labs and settings are kept.

about.title: About
about.description: Version, updates and what to send us when something breaks.

status.latestAt: You’re on the latest version, checked at {time}.
status.error: Couldn’t reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
status.installed: Version {version} is installed. Restarting Cyber CTF…
status.idle: Updates install automatically when you accept them from the banner.

about.diagnosticsDescription: Copies your version, OS and setup status, for a bug report or a support request.
about.logsDescription: What Cyber CTF wrote while it ran. Send them with a bug report or a support request.
about.firstRunDescription: Walk through the onboarding again. Your settings and labs are kept.

sharedFolder.title: Shared folder
sharedFolder.description: A folder on this computer that your attack box sees at {mount}: tools in, loot out. It stays when a lab is removed.
sharedFolder.pick: Folder to share with the attack box
